summaryZh: Brewer的UC San Diego Human Memory Laboratory研究脑区如何协同形成和提取记忆。团队使用功能与结构MRI研究健康志愿者及阿尔茨海默病等记忆障碍患者，并以开发评估脑损伤位置和严重程度的成像方法为目标。
researchQuestions: 脑的不同部分如何协同形成和提取记忆？

evidence.quote: The UC San Diego Human Memory Laboratory uses functional and structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to study memory processes in volunteers with healthy memory and in patients with memory difficulties, such as in Alzheimer's disease (AD).
The goal of the work is to understand how the different parts of the brain work together to make and retrieve memories.
The UC San Diego Human Memory Laboratory
We hope to develop imaging techniques that can measure the location and severity of brain damage in diseases of memory impairment
